title: Cochain scalar-adjoint tensor formula for strict systems
statement: Use the ordinary systems and section-normalized comparisons of [def-coef-semilinear-system-models, def-coef-semilinear-derived-calculus]. The degreewise ordinary horizontal adjoints define a cochain reduction. On the total tensor of two system complexes, scalar tensor chain comparison followed by evaluation chain comparison and this cochain reduction equals the total tensor of the two cochain reductions followed by evaluation chain comparison. No flatness or boundedness is needed for this chain identity.

source.place: Zheng Construction 4.1 horizontal system restrictions, with Stacks Tags 03EK, 03CZ and 06YY for module tensors and scalar adjunctions.

proof.text: Naturality of the ordinary adjunction transpose makes the degreewise horizontal adjoints commute with all differentials. Their resulting cochain map is the transpose through the induced adjunction on complexes of the actual cochain transition.

source.place: Zheng Construction 4.1 horizontal system restrictions, with Stacks Tags 03EK, 03CZ and 06YY for module tensors and scalar adjunctions.

proof.text: Precompose the claimed chain equality with every (p,q) tensor summand in degree p+q. The model summand equations, naturality of the reduction, and the ordinary tensor-reduction formula identify the composites. The inclusions into the total direct sums jointly detect equality, so the cochain maps agree.

theorem cochain_tensor_reduction (A : Data.{c, v, r} J B τ) {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (Systems.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ) ℤ) :
    (A.scalarTensorModel h).chain
        (((evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ m).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
        (((evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ m).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) ≫
      ((A.scalar h).model.E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        ((A.tensorEvaluationModel m).chain P Q) ≫
      cochainReduction.{c, v, r} J B τ A h
        ((totalTensor.{c, v, r} (coefficientSequenceTopology J)
          (systemRing.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ)).obj (P, Q)) =
    (totalTensor.{c, v, r} J (B n)).map
        (Prod.mkHom (cochainReduction.{c, v, r} J B τ A h P)
          (cochainReduction.{c, v, r} J B τ A h Q)) ≫
      (A.tensorEvaluationModel n).chain P Q
